meta.title: Restaura — your menu, on every table
meta.description: Publish a digital menu, export a print-ready PDF and generate table QR codes. Free to start.

hero.headline: Your menu, on every table
hero.subheadline: A digital menu, a print-ready PDF and table QR codes — from one place, in minutes.

digitalMenu.title: A menu that reads beautifully on every phone
digitalMenu.body: Your dishes, prices and allergens in a page that opens instantly — no app to install, no pinching to zoom. Change a price once and every guest sees it.

pdf.title: Print-ready, always up to date
pdf.body: Export the same menu as a clean PDF whenever the kitchen changes. Print it, email it, hand it to a supplier — no designer, no waiting.

qr.title: One scan from the table to the menu
qr.body: Generate a QR code for every table and put it where your guests already look. They scan, the menu opens, you are done.

create.title: Add your menu
create.body: Type in your categories and dishes, or paste them from what you already have.

generate.title: Generate PDF and QR codes
generate.body: One click gives you a print-ready PDF and a QR code for every table.

scan.title: Guests scan at the table
scan.body: They open the menu on their own phone — always the current one.

pricing.title: Start free. Grow when you need to.
pricing.subtitle: The Free plan is enough to put a real menu on your tables today. Pro and Pro Plus are on the way.

free.tagline: Everything you need for one menu.
